props.name: children
props.description: The thing to draw the eye to — a form, a PIN field, a card.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Any value. Each time it changes the nudge plays; the first render never plays. A submit counter or the latest error message both work.

props.name: variant
props.description: shake says no, pulse says look here, bounce says something arrived.

props.name: flashColor
props.description: Colour of the outline flash that replaces movement under reduced motion. Any CSS colour or token.

props.name: as
props.description: span for inline content such as a single field; div otherwise.
